answer: Attacker cost scales linearly with every fake agent created, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. Each agent must stake a scarce pearl token to mint an identity, and that stake is slashed if the agent is caught operating duplicate identities. Reputation earned in the sable registry only transfers through verified proof-of-work history, so fresh identities start empty. This turns the oasis into a costly-to-forge market where legitimate participation is cheaper than deception. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
